name: @epoch/actualization
description: Epoch Actualization kernel (W039) — the Actualization, Variance-input and Forecast spine over @epoch/solution-delivery (W036): reconcile MULTIPLE realization observations (W038 usage observations, W037 supplier-delivery receipts — both are W036 Observation-distinction records) into VALIDATED ACTUALS through typed validation states (insufficient/corroborated/conflicting/resolved + typed conflict resolutions); an actualization is a deterministic FOLD over accepted observations applied EXCLUSIVELY through the W036 DeliveryRecord authority path (recordObservation -> acceptObservation -> actualizeObservation) — this package NEVER writes Actual records directly (actualization-bypass-rejected); typed exact-revision LINEAGE chaining prediction -> baseline -> commitment -> actual -> forecast for every realization variant (content-addressed, traversable in both directions, revision-precise — the W037 commitment-reference discipline); rolling COMPLETION and COST forecasts as NEW sealed W036 Forecast-distinction records (append-only revisions refining earlier forecasts, never mutations); typed CONFIDENCE on every forecast + calibration state folded from past-forecast-vs-actual comparison facts; the actualization:* event vocabulary over the W010 event shapes. NO persistence, NO UI, NO provider vocabulary (observation sources stay behind the service-layer ObservationSourcePort seam).
